name: toast
title: Toast
description: A notification that slides in from below after a button click, holds, then auto-dismisses.
useWhen: Showing a success or error notification after an action (form submit, save, API call).
Ending a flow with a confirmation sliding in.
Demonstrating auto-dismiss feedback with a hidden, visible, hidden sequence.
avoidWhen: The feedback is persistent and must not auto-dismiss: use a banner or inline alert.
You need a blocking confirmation with actions: use alert-dialog.
You need a persistent side panel: use sheet.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Description
variables.description: Second line. Leave empty for a one-line toast.

variables.label: Variant
variables.description: Icon and tone of the toast.

variables.label: Button label
variables.description: Label of the button the cursor clicks.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
